summary: Part 5 dates the 咸康三年 (AD 337) enthronement acts in s0059 and the following Duan Liao campaign in s0060-s0066. The enthronement appointments (Lady Duan, Murong Jun) are correct point years, and the 337-338 campaign windows for Murong Huang, Duan Liao, Duan Lan, Song Hui and Shi Hu are supported uncertainty ranges. The Cao Cao and Sima Zhao rows are defective: s0059 only cites 魏武、晉文 as regency precedents in 337, so their imported regency spans and hints must become retrospective references. No unit in s0058-s0066 states a birth, death or age. This is not a full chapter approval.

itemChecks.event: Murong Huang's own campaign against Duan Liao with and then against Shi Hu, following his 337 kingship.
itemChecks.reason: s0056 anchors Huang's kingship in 咸康三年 (Jin Chengdi's Xiankang era began 335, so AD 337); the s0060-s0066 campaign follows and runs into the next year, so a 337-338 window states uncertainty about this event chain, not dynasty-wide activity.

itemChecks.reason: Duan Liao's flight (s0063) and false surrender (s0070) follow the 咸康三年 kingship in s0056 in the same campaign narrative; the window 337-338 brackets the campaign without asserting a point year.
